summary: We have developed a website that can be useful for both new and experienced farmers. Everything is organized simply: you can view the results of your crops, as well as weather forecasts, monitor their condition even when it is cloudy, check the forecast to plan irrigation and field work, and review how your land has changed over the years. Our goal is to make technology accessible to everyone, so you can make better decisions, manage your resources more wisely, and achieve stronger, more secure harvests.
details:
What does it do and how does it work? We made a simple website that brings together all the information a farmer needs in one place. You just open the page and it automatically finds your location. There you can see images of your crops, check if it is going to rain, learn about your soil, and know the best time to water. Everything uses free satellite data and trusted sources.

What benefits does it have? It helps farmers know when to plant, when to water, and when to harvest without guessing. This way we waste less water, take better care of the land, and get better harvests. It costs nothing and does not require expensive equipment.

What is the intended impact? We want everyone to have access to useful information to take care of their crops. Whether you are new or experienced, you can make better decisions and get more from your land.

What tools did we use? We built the website using simple languages: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. All the information comes from free public sources like NASA, FAO, and satellites such as Sentinel and Landsat. We did not use paid software or special equipment.

How is our project creative? Most of these tools are either very complicated to use or they cost money. We designed ours to be simple for everyone: you open it, see what you need, and that's it. You don't need to be good with technology to understand it.

What factors did we consider? We always kept things simple and clear. We only chose reliable information and made sure it works on any phone or computer. We also made sure it is completely free so anyone can use it.
